relations.subject: Olivier Auguste Lacombe
relations.evidence: From 1947 maître de conferences, then Professor at Université de Lille, until 1959.

relations.subject: Olivier Auguste Lacombe
relations.evidence: From 1955 also directeur d’études at 5e séction of É.P.H.É. teaching Indian religions , until 1971.

relations.subject: Olivier Auguste Lacombe

relations.subject: Olivier Auguste Lacombe
relations.evidence: From 1974 professeur honoraire (emeritus) at Université de Paris–Sorbonne.
